## Checklist

- [ ] The change matches an issue/specification, or the specification is updated.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior and edge cases.
- [ ] Calendar expected values are independent from the implementation under test.
- [ ] Migrations include compatibility/backup/rollback notes where applicable.
- [ ] User-controlled content and logs remain safely escaped/redacted.
- [ ] Keyboard, screen-reader, responsive, reduced-motion, and RTL effects were considered.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary, maintained, license-compatible, and locked.
- [ ] Documentation, `.env.example`, and `CHANGELOG.md` are current.
- [ ] No real secret, destination, personal reminder, dump, screenshot, trace, or log data is included.
